title: An old installed CLI answers Unsupported papyrus command with no hint to upgrade
description: The papyrus on this Mac is 5.72 while the site runs 5.81, and stories assign-research fails with: Unsupported papyrus command. Nothing suggests upgrading. papyrus login does not warn about a CLI older than the site. Also seen: the papyrus script on PATH points at a Python in another session's temporary scratchpad, so it can vanish, and stdout is buffered when redirected, so an agent running login --remote sees no approval URL until it sets PYTHONUNBUFFERED or -u.
